basic_info.description: Tucked away on a quiet street, just a short walk or cable car away from the financial district, your new 2Bd/2Ba home awaits. Stroll the Embarcadero or visit the Ferry Building for fine dining and the Saturday morning farmers' market. Gaze at the Coit Tower from the bright and sunny balcony, or take an invigorating climb up the Telegraph Hill staircase. Delightfully peaceful neighborhood, while still near Pier 39 and the trolley. This prime corner unit is spacious and bright, featuring an open plan L/D room with huge windows, plenty of built-ins, and a balcony for enjoying the bay breezes. Perfect for people who love to entertain, the large eat-in kitchen includes two full walls of cabinets, newer appliances, incl. Bosch D/W. Stacking W/D is conveniently tucked away in a closet near the main Bd, with an ensuite Ba & walk-in shower. The 2nd Ba has a tub if you'd prefer to soak after a long day. Consider creating a flex Bd/office: 2nd Bd can be a private oasis/w balcony access, or connected seamlessly with the main living area. Chat with the friendly security guards on duty 24/7. Complex is recently renovated, w/private landscaped courtyard, gym, & rooftop terrace. A secure storage & dedicated parking accessed by direct elevator are included. Walk score of 91, transit score of 82.
